source_native_semantics.depth: 640x480 16-bit monochrome PNG; zero is missing; meters=raw/5000
source_native_semantics.registration: depth is pre-registered by OpenNI into the RGB/color camera frame with 1:1 pixel correspondence
source_native_semantics.pose: timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw; color-camera optical-center pose with respect to the mocap world

intrinsic.choice: TUM-recommended ROS default for pre-registered depth without a second undistortion

fixed_window_rule.shared_start: max(first RGB timestamp, first depth timestamp, first pose timestamp)
fixed_window_rule.shared_end: min(last RGB timestamp, last depth timestamp, last pose timestamp)
fixed_window_rule.anchor: ceil(shared_start) to the next integer Unix second
fixed_window_rule.enumeration: all consecutive non-overlapping half-open [anchor+10*k, anchor+10*(k+1)) windows fully contained in shared coverage
fixed_window_rule.tail: discard the final incomplete tail deterministically
fixed_window_rule.selection_prohibition: no window may be added, removed, shifted, or replaced after any pose-speed or PB-H1 geometry value is inspected

association_and_pose_rule.rgb_depth: TUM associate.py semantics: globally sorted one-to-one nearest matches, offset 0, absolute timestamp difference <=0.020 s
association_and_pose_rule.pair_denominator: all chronological adjacent RGB rows within a fixed window whose dt is in [0.020,0.050] s, frozen before depth or pose joins
association_and_pose_rule.pose: interpolate color-camera mocap pose at each RGB timestamp; translation linear; quaternion xyzw shortest-arc SLERP; no extrapolation; enclosing pose span <=0.050 s

pb_h1_formula.sampling: the same fixed 8-pixel raster used by PB-H1 Bonn
pb_h1_formula.visibility: positive source depth, positive projected depth, both projections in bounds, radius >=8 px, nearest-depth winner per rounded full-projection destination
pb_h1_formula.distribution_summary: retain every pair row and report count, min, Q10, Q25, median, Q75, Q90, Q95, max for every continuous metric

coverage_gates.failure: local HOLD / NOT_EVALUABLE for fr2/rpy; do not substitute another source

diagnostic_bands_not_new_confirmation_ga.old_gate_counterexample: an evaluable fixed window is rotation-active and satisfies all rotation-like direct-geometry bands plus the parallax/angular ratio band, while its median raw translation speed is >0.02 m/s
diagnostic_bands_not_new_confirmation_ga.interpretation: bands are frozen discovery diagnostics inherited from PB-H1 physical checks and the prior rotation reference; all continuous distributions remain primary and no threshold may be tuned to rescue the result

terminal_rules.pass: fr2/rpy has sufficient source-native coverage and at least one fixed, evaluable rotation-dominant real window; report separately whether an old-gate counterexample exists
terminal_rules.hold: official authority, archive identity/format, RGB-depth association, pose synchronization, coordinate interpretation, depth support, or fixed-window coverage is insufficient
terminal_rules.after_pass: only then may a separately preregistered small real-data geometry canary be designed
